short.name: Wallet Balance Payments
short.desc: Store credit and wallet balance system for instant one-click checkout without re-entering payment details.

short.name: Seller Analytics Dashboard
short.desc: Sales trends, conversion funnel, and regional performance breakdown for sellers with exportable reports.

short.name: Bulk Key Purchase Discounts
short.desc: Tiered discounts for buyers purchasing 3+, 5+, or 10+ keys in a single order.

short.name: Price-Drop Alerts
short.desc: Email and push notifications when wishlisted titles drop below a buyer-set price threshold.

mid.name: Escrow for High-Value Bundles
mid.desc: Holds payout on large multi-key orders until buyer confirms successful redemption, reducing high-value dispute risk.

mid.name: Key Authenticity Checksum Verification
mid.desc: Publisher-aware checksum scheme so buyers can verify a key is genuine before redeeming it.

mid.name: Gift Key Sending
mid.desc: Purchase a key and send it directly to another buyer's email or account instead of redeeming it yourself.

mid.name: Seller Reputation ML Model
mid.desc: Predictive trust scoring for sellers based on listing history, dispute rate, and delivery speed.

mid.name: Regional Currency Auto-Display
mid.desc: Automatically show prices in the buyer's local currency using live FX rates, with manual override.

mid.name: Marketplace Public API (Read-Only)
mid.desc: Public read-only API for catalog and price data, aimed at price-tracking tools and community sites.

mid.name: Live Chat Buyer Support
mid.desc: Real-time chat support for order issues, replacing the current ticket-only support flow.

long.name: Loyalty Points Program
long.desc: Earn points on every purchase, redeemable for discounts on future orders. Early scoping phase.

long.name: Browser Price-Compare Extension
long.desc: Browser extension that surfaces Cerberus Market pricing while browsing other storefronts. Feasibility research.

long.name: Subscription Key Bundles
long.desc: Recurring monthly bundle of curated keys at a discount versus buying individually. Concept phase.

long.name: Cross-Marketplace Price Aggregation
long.desc: Show comparable listing prices from other marketplaces alongside our own for transparency. Exploring data-sourcing options.

long.name: Native Mobile App (iOS/Android)
long.desc: Dedicated native apps beyond the current responsive mobile web experience. Requirements gathering.

completed.name: Seller Verification Tiers
completed.desc: Standard, Verified, and Elite seller tiers with progressively stronger vetting and catalog benefits.

completed.name: Fraud Detection v2
completed.desc: Device fingerprinting and listing anomaly detection to reduce chargebacks and catalog abuse.

completed.name: AP-Southeast Region Launch
completed.desc: Localized pricing, regional payment rails, and edge routing for APAC buyers.

completed.name: Checkout Redesign
completed.desc: Single-page checkout flow with Apple Pay and Google Pay support.

templatePool.name: Buyer Trust Score
templatePool.desc: Public per-buyer reliability score based on dispute history, used to speed up seller approval of large orders.

templatePool.name: Seller Payout Insurance
templatePool.desc: Optional insurance pool covering sellers against buyer-side payment reversals after key delivery.

templatePool.name: Automated Regional Pricing Rules
templatePool.desc: Rules engine letting sellers set region-relative pricing multipliers instead of manual per-region prices.

templatePool.name: Key Bundle Builder
templatePool.desc: Lets sellers assemble and price custom multi-key bundles directly from their existing listings.
